title: Planned maintenance: NBN Werribee (VIC) network connection move
current_summary: We have planned maintenance at the Werribee (VIC) NBN point of interconnect. The work starts at 12:00 am on Wednesday 18 November 2026 and is scheduled to finish at 3:00 am (Melbourne time). We are moving services from legacy network connections to new ones. NBN services connected through this location may be disrupted for up to 3 hours during the window.

cause.reason: Planned maintenance to move services from legacy network connections to new ones at the Werribee NBN point of interconnect.

updates.content: We have scheduled maintenance at the Werribee (VIC) NBN point of interconnect. Between 12:00 am and 3:00 am (Melbourne time) on Wednesday 18 November 2026, we will be moving services from legacy network connections to new ones. NBN services connected through this location may be disrupted for up to 3 hours during this window. We will share another update if the schedule changes.
